<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>
<Cells count="1">
    <Range from="J1" to="K2" count="4">
        <Cell address="J1" content="1" style="bold" />
        <Cell address="J2" content="=J1 + 1" />
        <Cell address="K1" content="=$J$1 * 2" />
        <Cell address="K2" content="=sum(J1:J2)" />
    </Range>
</Cells>
